function.name: UseMCPServerTools
function.description: Execute a specific tool on an MCP server. Calls the remote tool with the given arguments and returns the result. Must conform to the inputSchema returned by DiscoverMCPServer.

serverName.description: The MCP server name where the tool is located.

toolName.description: The name of the tool to execute.

isDestructive.description: Whether the tool is destructive or not. Get this info from destructiveHint returned by DiscoverMCPServer.

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the tool.
